name: 注意力图一致性分析
description: 分析 spatial attention 模式 以检测 不一致 typical of AI生成的 images.
algorithm: Self-Attention Consistency Analysis for Synthetic Image Detection
mechanism: AI生成的 images often exhibit unnatural attention 模式 where different regions show inconsistent levels of detail. This method 分析 local 对比度, detail density, and sharpness 分布 maps.
parameters: Attention map: 梯度-weighted, Scales: 3 (fine/medium/coarse), Consistency: cross-scale 相关性
source: Zhao, T. et al. (2023) — Multi-Attentional Deepfake Detection, CVPR
useCase: Detecting AI生成的 images by identifying unnatural spatial attention 分布s

references.title: Zhao, T. et al. (2023) — Multi-Attentional Deepfake Detection, CVPR

strengths:
• Captures high-level semantic 伪影
• Works 跨 generation methods
• Multi-scale 分析
• Interpretable attention maps
limitations:
• Requires sufficient image complexity
• May struggle with simple scenes
• Attention 模式 vary by content
• Training-dependent performance
